title: dryopteris cruciata
intro: Dryopteris cruciata, commonly known as the Cross-leaved Wood Fern, is a type of fern found in Europe, Asia, and North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of D. cruciata include wound healing, antiseptic, and antiviral effects, making it a potential remedy for skin irritations and infections. The bioactive constituents of D. cruciata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
